description: Work with guides in the active document (View > Guides): add guides at pixel positions, lay out columns, rows and margins (New Guide Layout), make guides from the selected shape layer (New Guides From Shape), clear all guides or only canvas guides, or clear slices (View > Clear Slices). Returns the guides afterwards

clearExisting.description: layout: remove existing guides first. Default true

gutter.description: layout: space between columns and between rows, in pixels. Default 0

margin.description: layout: margins in pixels; a guide is placed at each margin given

positions.description: add: pixel positions from the top (horizontal) or left (vertical) edge

target.description: from_shape: the shape layer. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: edit_photoshop_guides
title: Edit Photoshop Guides
